## Exercises:

use

```{r}
#| label: import-data

thrombectomy <- medisr::thrombectomy

th_model <- glm(
  LoS ~ thrombectomy +
        prior_diabetes +
        age_at_diagnosis +
        prior_hypertention +
        sex +
        thrombectomy:prior_diabetes +
        thrombectomy:age_at_diagnosis +
        thrombectomy:prior_hypertention +
        thrombectomy:sex,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = thrombectomy
)
```

### A: Let's start by considering what a regression coefficient tells us.
